items.title: Finding a visual style for your game: Tips for beginners
items.zh_title: 为你的游戏找视觉风格：新手小贴士
items.summary: A beginner's guide to game art styles – pixel art, low-poly, cel-shaded, hand-drawn, and more – and five habits for keeping your game's look consistent.
items.zh_summary: 一份新手指南，介绍游戏美术风格：像素风、低多边形、赛璐璐、手绘等，以及保持游戏外观统一的五个习惯。
